# Kansas Prairie Webworks — LLM Access File
# Web design and AI automation agency
# Salina, Kansas

> Kansas Prairie Webworks is a web design and AI automation agency
serving small businesses across Central Kansas. Owner Kaleb Diehl
builds fast-loading websites, sets up Google Business Profiles and
Facebook pages, and runs AI-powered monthly content pipelines for
local contractors, cleaners, and service businesses in Saline,
Ottawa, Lincoln, Dickinson, Ellsworth, and Cloud counties.
Phone: 785-577-7695
Website: https://kansasprairiewebworks.com

## Tech Brief (/insights/)

Sourced analysis of AI, search, payments, tokenization and the
infrastructure underneath them, written for a senior reader. Every
dynamic figure carries a primary source and an as-of date. Published on
the main domain rather than a subdomain, on purpose.

/insights/index.html — Tech Brief hub, all briefs newest first.

/insights/methodology.html — Editorial method, source tiers, and how
  dated data is refreshed and marked.

/insights/october-comment-deadlines-sec-crypto-genius-act.html — Treasury's GENIUS Act rule closes for comment October 19, 2026,
  the SEC's Regulation Crypto Assets October 20. Both are proposals;
  neither date binds anyone.
  Published 2026-09-05.

/insights/future-ready-small-business-checklist.html — The real dividing line for small businesses is not old versus new
  technology. It is whether your systems respond in real time or
  only in scheduled batches.
  Published 2026-08-20.

/insights/google-search-console-ai-visibility-bing-citation-share.html — Google and Bing both shipped AI answer visibility reporting in
  June 2026. Google reports impressions only, no clicks. Bing's
  Citation Share is not a scoreboard.
  Published 2026-08-20.

/insights/genius-act-stablecoin-rules-july-18-2026-deadline-missed.html — Congress set July 18, 2026 as the GENIUS Act rulemaking deadline.
  The public record showed proposals, not final rules, and the
  effective date still advances.
  Published 2026-08-19, updated 2026-09-05.

/insights/sec-regulation-crypto-assets-proposal-what-changed.html — The SEC's Regulation Crypto Assets is a proposed rule, not law.
  What actually changed is the shift from case-by-case enforcement
  to written compliance pathways.
  Published 2026-08-19, updated 2026-09-05.

/insights/tokenized-stocks-sec-rules-24-7-equity-markets.html — The SEC approved tokenized share trading on Nasdaq with the same
  CUSIP and the same shareholder rights. But it also put them on the
  same order book, which quietly undoes the 24/7 story.
  Published 2026-08-17, updated 2026-08-19.
